driver_weight_model.rationale: Driver weights are estimated on the matching value-per-revenue surface (EV/Revenue for enterprise displays, P/Revenue for equity displays) and translated into the CFO-native multiple. Weights therefore mean market value impact, not a mechanical denominator effect inside EV/EBITDA or P/E.

forward_expectations.method: forward expectation model: historical market/support residuals predict future driver changes after controlling for current level, momentum, and available cycle context; only sign-aligned drivers with strong held-out forecast precision are allowed to explain the current valuation gap

validation.contract: contribution_log = valuation_slope_log_per_value * market_implied_delta; driver_log + outside_log = value_surface_log_gap
validation.point_in_time: All valuation, financial, dividend, buyback, and liquidity fields are filtered to information available on or before the as-of date.

decomposition.method: raw-value bounded decomposition: allocate the market/support log gap across material performance drivers by each driver’s actual-value room to an observed peer-range bound; remainder is residual expectation outside measured drivers

market_expectations.method: reverse value-surface assumption: solve each material controlled-impact driver in actual metric units where possible; decompose current market multiple versus model support into measured driver bridge plus residual outside measured financial drivers

method: Dashboard display multiples are CFO-native: EV/EBITDA for enterprise value, P/E for equity value, and EV/Revenue where selected. Driver weights are estimated on the matching value-per-revenue surface so operating quality signals keep their economic meaning: EV/Revenue for EV/EBITDA displays and P/Revenue for P/E displays. The native multiple is then translated algebraically from the value surface (EV/EBITDA = EV/Revenue / EBITDA margin; P/E = P/Revenue / net income margin). The retained native EV/EBITDA and P/E model diagnostics remain available as suitability checks, but current dashboard driver priorities use controlled p75-to-p25 valuation-impact weights from the value-surface v2 peer-percentile model. Peer sets are selected through validated optimizer/template/GICS fallbacks, cycle context is generic when available, and all displayed fields are gated to information available on or before the as-of date.
